reason: The app in our own name would fix the complaint I hear at the desk every week, and a free pilot costs me little money. But two founders with one club not yet live is too thin for me to put 950 members and our invoicing through, and nothing here earns me more per member or per guest, so I'll wait.
objection: GOLF.NL is free and already books tee times and takes payment. If I move our members' booking and invoices to a two-person company and they stall or vanish, I'm the one the board blames, and I don't see extra green fee, buggy, lesson or sponsor revenue in it to justify that risk.
would_change_my_mind: Golfclub Zwolle live for a full season with its board telling me on the phone that members actually use it, plus proof it brings in money: guest green fees and extras sold through the app, or a sponsor spot in the app.
